name: ajilty
description: Homegrown agentic tooling for Claude Code.

plugins.name: orchestrate
plugins.description: Standing operator loop: feed goals of any altitude; capability-scoped personas work in parallel worktrees, shared-target steps run one at a time, verification is independent, and every run is journaled for retrospectives.

plugins.name: guards
plugins.description: Hooks that guard against known failure modes: JSON/YAML syntax validation (incl. .md frontmatter) and check-only Markdown lint on every Edit/Write with findings fed back for same-turn self-correction, plus a PreToolUse gate that denies sweeping git staging (add -A/./-u, commit -a).

plugins.name: playbooks
plugins.description: Opinionated workflows for how the operator works: user-invoked skills across meta, office, coding, and security domains.

plugins.name: edges
plugins.description: Knowledge to overcome model gaps: auto-invoked working-with-<tool> notes on sharp edges of specific tools and vendors.
